title: Private Event & Banquet Services — Package Capacity, Minimum Spend and Diary Schedule
content:
Six packages carry Private Event & Banquet Services, and the figures below are the ones printed against each of them for guest numbers, minimum spend and diary space. A booking takes the column of the package its agreement is written against.

## Schedule A — capacity, spend and diary figures

| Package | Smallest guest count | Largest guest count | Minimum food and beverage spend, USD per event | Events a year the package is written against | Booking notice before the event date, calendar days | Confirmed unserved events the agreement may carry at once | Published dates in the year taking no bookings |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 4 | 20 | 250 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 4 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 10 | 60 | 900 | 4 | 7 | 8 | 6 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 25 | 180 | 2800 | 6 | 14 | 12 | 8 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 60 | 350 | 6500 | 4 | 30 | 10 | 10 |
| Gala Reception Package | 150 | 900 | 14500 | 2 | 60 | 6 | 12 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 200 | 1200 | 42000 | 1 | 120 | 4 | 14 |

## Reading of the columns

The smallest guest count is the guest count the package is written for and the largest is the guest count the package handles. The minimum food and beverage spend is the smallest food and beverage spend the package is written against, for one event. The booking notice column is the calendar days of notice a booking needs before the event date. The diary column is the number of confirmed unserved events the agreement may carry at one time, and the last column is the number of published dates in the year on which the package takes no bookings.

## Points of judgement

A package's guest window is read from both ends: on the Seated Banquet Package a party of 60 guests sits inside the window and a party of 59 does not, while a party of 350 sits inside it and a party of 351 does not.

The three money and diary columns move in different directions across the packages. The minimum food and beverage spend rises at every step, from 250 on the Meeting Room Refreshment Package to 42000 on the Multi-Day Conference Residency Package, while the diary allowance rises to 12 on the Conference Day Delegate Package and then falls back to 4 on the Multi-Day Conference Residency Package, the larger rooms being held longer for each event.
